《巴宰語詞典》p.212，muximux- 條下派生詞

senses.en: to slice meat or vegetables, to cut (meat)
to weed in dry fields, to pluck, to pull out a plant (as a small tree or vegetables)
to awake, to wake up (by oneself)
to catch up (as in a race), to be in time for, as when catching a bus
to rest one's chin on one's hands
to erect a pole, plant or insert a pole into the ground
